# The North Ridge Patrol

*Skarra sends a patrol over the North Ridge every day, and today it is short a pair of hands. Hunt 40 Ridge Stumps on the North Ridge and report at the Trail Watch post.*

## Objectives

- Defeat 40 [Ridge Stump](../monsters/ridge_stump.md) in [The North Ridge](../maps/north_ridge.md)
- Reach the Trail Watch post in [The North Ridge](../maps/north_ridge.md)

## Rewards

- 2,150 EXP
- 320 mesos
- [Orange Potion](../items/orange_potion.md) x10
- +20 standing with Midbarium
- +30 standing with [Skarra](../npcs/skarra_uskari.md)
